meta.name: Tell Me That You Love Me
meta.description: Since he lost his hearing, Cha Jin-woo has gotten used to his solitary life. One day, an aspiring actress Jung Mo-eun, enters his quiet daily routine.

videos.title: Greet
videos.overview: Jin-woo and Mo-eun cross paths in Jeju. She gets upset because he keeps ignoring her.

videos.title: Chord
videos.overview: Jin-woo and Mo-eun meet again in Seoul and try to get to know each other better, but it's not easy.

videos.title: Tears
videos.overview: Jinwoo and Moeun get closer. When Moeun reads an interview in the art centre newsletter, she sympathises with the sense of alienation Jinwoo felt.

videos.title: Empathy
videos.overview: At late night, Jinwoo gets a call and leaves without telling Moeun. Moeun gets worried as he doesn't return for his lectures.

videos.title: Regards
videos.overview: Jinwoo goes to the theatre to root for Moeun. The play ends well and her feelings for him get bigger and bigger.

videos.title: Companion
videos.overview: When Seokyung shows up unannounced, Jinwoo feels confused. Moeun thinks that they are just old friends and envies Seokyung her fluent sign language.

videos.title: Beginning
videos.overview: When Johan hears Moeun seems to be dating someone, he gets curious to know if it is true and who the guy is. Seokyung makes Jinwoo an offer.

videos.title: Influence
videos.overview: Moeun, an aspiring actress, crosses paths with Jinwoo in Jeju. However, Moeun gets Jinwoo wrong and thinks he keeps ignoring her.

videos.title: Reasons
videos.overview: Jin-woo meets Mo-eun's parents, and Mo-eun finds out Jin-woo and Seo-kyung used to be lovers.

videos.title: Courage
videos.overview: Mo-eun roots for Jin-woo's exhibition, but it bothers her that Seo-kyung and he meet often.

meta.slogan: We found love in a silent world.
